thread:
devon: quick ask — can someone run a 1k-token latency profile on edge-03 (on-prem)? I suspect NUMA/cpu-pin fallout after the kernel bump. need p50/p95 and a perf profile if you have time.

alex: can do. which image + model + args? also want to know if we should run with and without cpu pinning.

devon: image: docker.redwood/inference:2026-03-15, model=redwood-open-7b, seq=1024, batch=1, kv_cache=on, quant=4bit. run baseline with default scheduler and then with --cpuset-cpus=0-7.

maria: also collect `numactl --hardware`, `cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/online`, and `nvidia-smi topo --matrix`. small note: run `nvidia-smi dmon -s u` during the test for GPU util.

alex: ack. i'll run two 3-min runs and grab perf. do you want flamegraphs?

devon: yes flamegraphs please. upload to s3://redwood-qa/inference/edge-03/1772145801/ and include p50/p95 + token/s.

sam: scheduler note — edge-03 is in rack B2 and currently has cgroups memlock limit 4G. i'll temporarily bump to 16G for the test, ping me when you start so i can revert after. infra-bot: action=quota-adjust node=edge-03 owner=sam

alex: starting now. command i'll run (inside container):
```
docker run --rm --gpus all --privileged \  
  -e MODEL=redwood-open-7b \  
  -e SEQ_LEN=1024 \  
  docker.redwood/inference:2026-03-15 \  
  --batch 1 --kv-cache on --quant 4bit --cpuset-cpus=0-7
```
then perf: `perf record -e cycles -aR -g -- sleep 180` inside the container and `perf script | stackcollapse-perf.pl > out.folded` -> `flamegraph.pl out.folded > perf.svg`.

maria: small caution — running perf inside container may need CAP_SYS_ADMIN; if you want avoid privileged, run `perf` on host and map PIDs.

tia: i'll watch the network metrics for IB, in case RDMA changes cause jitter.

alex: uploads done: s3://redwood-qa/inference/edge-03/1772145801/{baseline,cpuset}/. included perf.svg and raw perf.data. quick numbers: baseline p50=38ms p95=92ms tokens/s=22. cpuset p50=40ms p95=130ms tokens/s=19.

devon: thanks — big p95 regression with cpuset, suggests core contention or bad NUMA placement. maria/sam can you help interpret CPU bindings vs GPU locality?

maria: looks like when cpuset=0-7 we forced avatars on different NUMA node from the GPU PCIe. send `lspci -vv` and `numactl --hardware` dumps and i'll map.

sam: i'll re-run with cpuset pinned to the GPU local cores (8-15) and report back in ~30m.

devon: perfect. great quick turnaround everyone :thumbsup:
